auth.loginSubhead: Sign in to Shreenathji Traders — bills, dakhla, rojmer & silak.
auth.forgotSubhead: We’ll email a reset code / link. Enter it here to set a new password.
auth.forgotCodeHint: Enter the email for your account. We’ll send a reset link — then enter the code from that email (or open the link in this app).
auth.resetSent: Reset email sent — check your inbox.
auth.resetSentEnterCode: Email sent. Open the link, or paste the code from the email below.
auth.resetCodeReady: Reset code loaded — set your new password.
auth.enterResetCodeHint: Paste the code from your email (oobCode in the link), then choose a new password.
auth.resetPasswordOk: Password updated — sign in with your new password.
auth.emailVerifiedOk: Email verified — you can sign in now.
auth.errInvalidResetCode: That reset code is invalid or expired.
auth.errPasswordMismatch: New password and confirmation don’t match.
auth.alternateSubhead: Sign in with a one-time email link or an SMS code.
auth.emailCodeHint: We’ll send a sign-in link to your email. Open it on this device.
auth.smsHint: We’ll text a 6-digit code. SMS needs Phone Auth enabled in Firebase (may require Blaze).
auth.emailLinkSent: Link sent — open it from your email to finish signing in.
auth.switchToSignup: New here, or invited? Create your account
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.unauthorizedBody: This account is not registered for Shreenathji Traders. Ask the owner to invite you, or try a different account.
auth.unverifiedBody: We emailed a verification code to your inbox (check Spam). Enter that code below to finish signing in.
auth.verificationSent: Verification code sent — check your inbox and Spam.
auth.verificationResent: New code sent — check inbox and Spam.
auth.verifyCodeHint: Open the email, copy the code after oobCode=, or paste the whole link here.
auth.stillUnverified: That code didn’t work or email isn’t verified yet. Check the code and try again.
auth.phoneNeedsEmailInvite: Phone sign-in can’t accept email invites. Sign in with the invited email (or link an email to this account), then try again.
auth.errInvalidEmail: That email doesn’t look right — check it and try again.
auth.errInvalidCode: That code didn’t match or has expired — request a new one and try again.
auth.errEmailInUse: An account already exists for that email — try signing in instead.
auth.errWeakPassword: Password needs to be at least 6 characters.
auth.errBadCredentials: Email or password didn’t match — check them and try again.
auth.errTooMany: Too many tries — wait a bit before trying again.
auth.errNetwork: Couldn’t reach the internet — check your connection and try again.
auth.errProviderDisabled: This sign-in method isn’t enabled yet. In Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method, enable Email/Password.
auth.errUnauthorizedDomain: This website domain isn’t allowed for sign-in. Add it under Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains (include shreenath-traders.web.app and localhost).
auth.errContinueUri: Email couldn’t be sent — continue URL domain isn’t authorized. Add this site under Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, and open the app via localhost (not 127.0.0.1).
auth.errSmsBilling: SMS sign-in isn’t available on this Firebase plan. Use email/password or email link instead.
auth.errAccountExists: An account already exists with a different sign-in method for this email.
auth.errGeneric: Something didn’t go through — please try again.
auth.errorBody: Couldn’t load your account. Check your connection and try again.
